messages:
alice: hitting a 400 on POST /v1/rerank from our mobile client. response says "invalid_request: items must be array of objects" but payload looks like this:
```bash
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"payload": {"items": [{"id": 12345, "candidates": [{"score": "0.9", "text": "Option A"}, {"score": "NaN", "text": null}] , "top_k": 0}, {"id": 67890, "candidates": [], "top_k": "1"}]}}'
```
Can someone tell me what I'm doing wrong?

sam: can you paste the raw response body (not just the status) and the request-id header if present? also which SDK/version?

alice: full response:```json
{"error": {"type":"invalid_request","message":"items must be an array of objects with non-empty candidates","code":400}, "request_id": "rq_2026_3023_xxxxx"}
```
sdk: mobile-sdk-2.3.0 (we rolled this week).

maria: a few quick things to check: 1) our API requires items[].id to be a string (numeric ids are rejected by some validation layers). 2) candidates must be a non-empty array for each item (top_k >= 1). 3) scores must be numeric, and text must be a string. your payload shows numbers as bare ints and scores as strings/NaN and one candidate has null text — that will fail validation. also i notice your body wrapped the real payload under a top-level "payload" key — our rerank endpoint expects the items array at the root (i.e. {"items": [...]}) not nested.

sam: +1. common mobile bug: JSON encoder used by sdk-v2 wrapped requests and coerced ints to numbers (fine) but also serialized NaN/undefined for missing scores which breaks our strict schema. can you try a minimal repro with a single item, id as a string, and a single candidate with a numeric score? e.g.:

```json
{"items": [{"id": "12345","top_k": 1,"candidates": [{"text": "Option A","score": 0.9}]}]}
```

alice: tried that exact body via curl and it worked. using same client it still fails intermittently. looks environment-specific (iOS only).

maria: sounds like the mobile sdk is sometimes sending an empty candidates array for the second item (or converting nulls). workaround: ensure the client always serializes candidates as [] -> if empty, remove the item or provide a placeholder candidate. we'll escalate to eng-runtime for a better validation error that pinpoints the failing index. can you also attach the mobile request payload captured from the device (raw bytes)?

ops-bot: trace logged: request_id=rq_2026_3023_xxxxx, route=/v1/rerank, status=400, validator:items.candidates.nonempty, node=runtime-23, trace=tr_3023456abcd

sam: created internal ticket INF-4721 and set priority P2. tagging @eng-runtime and @sdk-team. pls attach the raw device payload and the SDK logs. for the immediate unblock: coerce ids to strings and ensure top_k >= 1 and candidates contains at least one candidate with text and numeric score. also ensure Content-Type: application/json (mobile libs sometimes send text/plain).

alice: got it — attaching raw payload and logs in the ticket. thanks! :thumbsup:

maria: noted. adding short doc clip to ticket: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/rerank#request-format . will follow up once eng-runtime confirms a clearer error message or patch for SDK coercion.
